execution_provenance: The locked seed is persisted in the discovery run. Additional controls were executed read-only from the same frozen inputs and transcribed from terminal output; they were not part of the pre-fit lock and cannot select or alter the champion.

raw_grouped_target_permutations.description: Permute observed targets independently within every target-season and position group before fitting the already-selected procedure.
raw_grouped_target_permutations.interpretation: The predeclared zero-null sentinel does not center at zero. Eleven conditional repeats are insufficient for a confirmatory full-selection permutation test.

fixed_prediction_validation_label_permut.description: Hold the selected discovery predictions fixed and permute validation labels within target-season and position groups.

iid_rademacher_training_labels.description: Replace every training target with independent centered -1 or +1 noise before fitting the selected procedure.

within_group_standardized_target_permuta.description: Z-score targets inside each target-season and position group, then permute before fitting.

conclusion: Restoration and scoring controls center near zero, antithetic centered labels reverse sign, and three exploratory standardized-target repeats did not reproduce the positive raw-null mean. Evidence favors a skew-and-feature-geometry effect over a direct real-label path. The raw shuffled-target sentinel nevertheless failed its zero-null interpretation and must be reported as failed.
